requirement.description: The receive_messages method is incorrectly implemented. It returns a generator function instead of an async iterator, causing 'async for' to fail with 'requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine'.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method should return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be properly consumed with async for loops. The method signature and implementation must be corrected to return a proper async iterator.

requirement.description: The __aenter__ and __aexit__ methods are not properly managing transport lifecycle. The context manager should ensure that disconnect is called even when exceptions occur.
requirement.contract: The ClaudeSDKClient context manager (__aenter__, __aexit__) must ensure proper cleanup by calling disconnect() in all cases, including when exceptions are raised.

requirement.description: The read_messages method is an alias for receive_messages but doesn't correctly implement the async iterator protocol, causing the same async iteration issues.
requirement.contract: The read_messages method should behave consistently with receive_messages and properly return an async iterator.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method calls transport.receive_messages() but doesn't ensure the correct async iterator protocol is maintained.
requirement.contract: The process_query method should correctly consume and yield from transport.receive_messages() to maintain proper async iteration behavior.

requirement.description: The receive_messages method in ClaudeSDKClient doesn't properly handle the async iterator protocol from the transport layer.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method should correctly forward the async iterator from the transport layer without breaking the async iteration chain.
